It does not compute that field from code commits, browser invocations or historical correction labels. A future supplied value4 would reject; no SC02 trusted review exists and no such rejection has been observed. Preserve all history and establish the source-bound mapping when assembling the actual report; do not invent an exception gate from the ordinal alone.

ownerDecision.subject: Preserve historical corrections and map actual final trusted review.iterations to its documented independent review scope when that report is assembled.
ownerDecision.boundary: The current emitted planner blocker is missing Crossdeck experience design. No SC02 final trusted review has been assembled or rejected.
